RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.title: Ascensions
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.historyHelp:
[gold]Use Run History[/gold]
Sets every Ascension to the highest level your runs have earned. Ascensions without runs stay where they are.
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.intro:
Each Ascension starts at what you have unlocked on [gold]{profile}[/gold]. Use the arrows to lower it or raise it, up to the highest level.

Blitz and every character except Ironclad have to be unlocked in the game before their Ascension can be raised here. Characters appear once you have selected them in character select, and Blitz once it is unlocked.

Reset puts every row back to what is unlocked; Use Run History sets them to what your runs earned. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

[gold]{scope}[/gold]
Earned {earned} over {runs} {runs:plural:run|runs}. It is replayed from your run history, so runs missing from it (another device, deleted history) make it too low.

[gold]{scope}[/gold]
No runs in your history yet, so Use Run History leaves it as it is.
